moments.evidence_quote: The scene is a residential street with parked cars lining both sides.
moments.caption: The scene is a residential street with parked cars lining both sides. A white pickup truck is driving ahead in the same lane, and its brake lights are illuminated, indicating it is slowing or stopping. The road is a single-lane, two-way street with no visible traffic lights or stop signs. The sky is overcast, and trees with autumn foliage line the sidewalks. No pedestrians, cyclists, or other moving vehicles are visible in the immediate vicinity. The white pickup truck remains the primary moving vehicle, and there are no apparent traffic violations or hazards in the scene.
moments.what_happened: A person was near the road on a residential street lined with parked cars, and the vehicle ahead was braking.
moments.what_you_did_right: You eased off and gave the person room before moving on.
moments.why_it_matters: Riders notice a smooth early stop as careful driving. A late brake feels like a mistake even when you did the right thing.

moments.evidence_quote: The scene is captured from a vehicle’s dashboard camera, showing a street intersection under an overcast sky.
moments.caption: The scene is captured from a vehicle’s dashboard camera, showing a street intersection under an overcast sky. A white pickup truck with a utility bed and red and black markings is stopped at the intersection, facing away from the camera. The truck has a roof rack and is positioned on the left side of the frame. A stop sign is visible on the right side of the road, mounted on a pole. The road is paved and appears to be a two-lane street with a sidewalk on the right side. Trees with autumn foliage line both sides of the street, and a tall residential building is visible on the left. Other vehicles are seen in the distance, including a dark-colored SUV and a white car. There are no pedestrians or cyclists visible in the scene. The truck remains stationary throughout the clip, and there are no indications of any traffic violations or immediate hazards.
moments.what_happened: A white pickup truck was stopped ahead at the intersection.
moments.what_you_did_right: You kept a clear gap behind the truck while it waited.
moments.why_it_matters: Space is what turns a hard brake into a gentle one. Riders feel the difference in every stop.

moments.evidence_quote: The video shows a residential street with a single lane in each direction.
moments.caption: The video shows a residential street with a single lane in each direction. The road is lined with parked cars on both sides, and there are no visible traffic lights or stop signs. A white truck is seen driving ahead in the same direction as the camera vehicle. There are no pedestrians, cyclists, or other moving vehicles besides the truck. The environment includes trees with autumn foliage and houses on both sides of the street. The sky is overcast, and the overall scene is calm with no apparent hazards or violations.
moments.what_happened: Cyclists were on a narrow residential street with parked cars on both sides.
moments.safer_next_time: Stay back until the next lane is clear, then give at least a full car door of space as you pass.
moments.why_it_matters: A close pass frightens the cyclist and your rider, and it leaves no room if the cyclist swerves around a pothole.

Traffic is moderate, with several vehicles visible ahead and alongside. A white car is directly ahead in the same lane, and a black pickup truck passes on the left. The road surface is dry and marked with standard lane lines. There are no traffic lights or signals visible in this segment. The environment includes an overpass with a no-parking sign and a concrete retaining wall on the left, with vegetation and trees on the right. No pedestrians, cyclists, or trains are present. No collisions or unusual maneuvers are evident.
moments.what_happened: Traffic was moving on a multi-lane arterial road, with trucks in the next lanes.
moments.what_you_did_right: You stayed in your lane and kept steady space to the traffic ahead.
moments.why_it_matters: Space is what turns a hard brake into a gentle one. Riders feel the difference in every stop.

moments.what_happened: The vehicle approached an intersection on a two-way road.
moments.safer_next_time: Stop before the crosswalk, look both ways along it, and only start the turn when the whole crossing is empty.
moments.why_it_matters: Turns are where drivers and pedestrians both think they have the right of way. Waiting costs a few seconds and removes the conflict.
